notes: Bulbing fennel — cool-season; bolts in heat. Plant late summer for fall harvest.

careTasks.title: Florence fennel can be harvested when the “bulbs” are about the size of tennis balls by digging the “bulb” and cutting off the root and cutting back the top.

seasonalTasks.title: Plant more fennel
seasonalTasks.body: For a steady supply of bulbs, plant a short row again every 3 to 4 weeks.

seasonalTasks.title: Mound soil around fennel bulbs
seasonalTasks.body: When the bulbs start to swell, mound soil around them so they stay pale and mild.
